name: rt_longroof_concept
subject: the long roof: the big grey slopes are steep pitched roofs of red clay tiles falling to the right in steps, seen from the side, each slope with its tile courses and a ridge at the top and the eaves at the bottom; the flat grey run in the middle where the dog stands is a flat roof with a sandstone parapet cap; under the roofs, ochre plaster house fronts with windows; the thin grey stack at the top left is a far chimney with clay pots

slot.where: Rooftops, the long roof down to the cafe, camera y 160 x 6700

extra: Image 2 is the approved painting of the hotel roof in this same level: use exactly its materials, colours, light, dark outlines and pixel size (warm ochre plaster walls, sandstone parapet caps in blocks, red clay roof tiles, green copper, stucco chimney stacks with clay pots, glass lanterns in black iron frames, dark brown window frames); do not copy its buildings or its layout. Replace every grey placeholder shape completely with finished art, nothing see-through, no grey left. Surfaces as flat shapes with 1 px joints, not texture. Behind the near roofs, the far town as its own clean band of red roofs, chimneys and the church spire, lighter and softer in colour than the near roofs; the roofs and edges the dog walks on are the darkest and most contrasted. No stone rows that look like ledges just above the dog's head. Every drop reads as an opening. Keep the dog exactly as it is; keep the small grey metal vent boxes and the orange loose tiles where they are.
